sample_grain: one building and one complete 24-hour day
pearson_24h: Pearson correlation of sample and 30-day median reference across 24 hourly pairs; 0 if constant
label_status: rule-derived provisional labels; no expert validation
image_method: Ledoit-Wolf shrunk covariance converted to Pearson correlation of 24 hourly columns across 7 consecutive days ending on sample date, then ReLU
image_encoding: 24x24 RGBA PNG: correlation <=0 green (0,127,102,255), correlation 1 yellow (255,255,102,255)
